company_name: ZhongAn Online P & C Insurance Co., Ltd.
model: P&C insurer FCFE at cost of equity, net debt held at zero (engine route)

equity_bridge.item: ZhongAn International JV (43.43%; ZA Bank, Peak3, ZA Life) at 1.5x the Group's share of net assets
equity_bridge.note: FY2025 AR note 25(b): Group's share of net assets 1,189.8m; goodwill 3,545.9m; impairment -698.5m; carrying amount 4,037.2m (4,822m total associates+JV line at 30 June 2026). The JV lost 169m in 2025 (-419m in 2024) even though ZA Bank itself turned profitable (HKD17m FY2025, HKD71m H1 2026, net revenue HKD578m +26.6%); Peak3 and ZA Life are still loss-making. The audited value-in-use of 4,037m rests on 3.5bn of goodwill that was impaired by 698m less than a year ago, so it is not taken at book: 1.5x the share of net assets (~1.4x ZA Bank's own book for Hong Kong's largest and first-profitable virtual bank) = 1,785m. Book (4,037m) would add a further RMB1.34/share (HKD1.57) and is the bull-side view; the share of net assets alone (1,190m) is the bear-side view. The JV's and associates' share of results (-67.8m FY2025, -32.3m H1 2026) is EXCLUDED from the margin path so this is not double-counted.

equity_bridge.item: Associates (ZhongAn Microloan 41.18%, ZhongAn Xinke 35.49%, Nova Insight) at book
equity_bridge.note: FY2025 AR note 25(a): 457.2 + 299.5 + 81.4 = 838.1m at 31 Dec 2025, all profitable in 2025 (share of profit +40.2m). Their results are excluded from the margin path.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: FY2026-30 insurance revenue path (9%, 6%, 7%, 6.5%, 6%), anchored on FY2025 GWP +6.9%, H1 2026 ex-consumer-finance GWP +14.6% and total GWP -0.6%
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3-yr CAGR (17.3%, FY2022 15.8bn -> FY2025 25.4bn) is inflated by the FY2023 ZhongAn International disposal gain (3,784m) and the FY2025 placing (3,551m); organic retained earnings added ~2.6bn over three years (~5%/yr). Revenue CAGRs span the HKFRS 4 -> HKFRS 17 break (FY2022 22,189 is earned premium; FY2023+ is insurance revenue). EPS and FCF CAGRs are not meaningful: EPS -0.76 (FY2022) -> 2.77 (FY2023, disposal gain) -> 0.41 -> 0.70, and reported FCF is premium float.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs computed from Metrics.csv: revenue FY2020 18,493 -> FY2025 33,485 (5-yr 12.6%), FY2022 22,189 -> FY2025 33,485 (3-yr 14.7%); equity FY2020 15,705 -> FY2025 25,449 (10.1%), FY2022 15,766 -> FY2025 25,449 (17.3%). Owner-FCF series not used: this is an insurer.

scenario_narratives.base: Insurance revenue +9% in FY2026 fading to 3.5% by FY2035; pre-tax margin (ex-JV) 8.7% in FY2026 normalising to 8.0% and rebuilding to 8.5%; 23% tax; payout 40% rising to 60% as the 288% solvency ratio drifts toward 200%; CoE 11%, terminal 3% capped at 12x FCFE. ZhongAn International JV carried at 1.5x share of net assets and associates at book in the equity bridge.
scenario_narratives.bull: Double-digit growth for four more years on health/pet/NEV, combined ratio to 94%, technology segment profitable, 5% investment yield: margin 9.5-11%; distributions start in FY2027 and reach 70% of earnings; CoE 10%, terminal 3.5% capped at 14x FCFE.
scenario_narratives.bear: Fair-value gains reverse, combined ratio back to 97%, 3.5% investment yield, technology losses return: margin 5-5.5%; growth 2-4%; Board retains 65-80% of earnings indefinitely; CoE 12.5%, terminal 2% capped at 10x FCFE.

valuation_philosophy.summary: ZhongAn is valued on the equity cash it can distribute, discounted at an 11% CNY cost of equity, not on a book-value compounding model (its ROE of 3-6% is below the cost of equity, so book does not compound) and not on owner FCF (which for an insurer is premium float). The flows carry the online P&C business only; the ZA Bank/Peak3 JV and the associates are added once in the equity bridge at conservative marks and their equity-accounted results are excluded from the margin. The single most important assumption is the payout path: the company has surplus solvency (288%) and has never paid a dividend, and the scenarios differ mainly on whether and how fast that changes. At the current price the stock trades at ~0.49x 30 June 2026 book (RMB16.0/share = HKD18.8) and ~5-6x FY2026E earnings; the market is giving no credit for the surplus capital or the JV.
key_risks_to_valuation: Payout: if the Board never distributes, FCFE is zero and value accrues only through retained earnings compounding at a sub-CoE ROE -- the bear scenario's 20-35% payout is the floor assumed, not zero

Investment income: ~45-55% of normalised pre-tax profit is investment return on ~42bn of float; a 1pp change in total investment yield is ~0.4bn of PBT (~1.2pp of margin), and FY2022 shows the downside can be a net loss
Combined ratio: digital lifestyle (46.8% of GWP) runs at 99.2% and NEV auto mix is raising the loss ratio; every 1pp on the combined ratio is ~0.35bn of underwriting profit

JV mark: the ZhongAn International carrying value (4,037m, 3.5bn of goodwill) was impaired by 698m in FY2025; the bridge uses 1,785m, and a further impairment would hit reported (not adjusted) profit and sentiment
Dilution: the 2025 placing added 14.6% to the share count at HK$18.25; another raise to fund fintech/ZA Bank at today's price would be far more dilutive
FX: value is built in CNY and quoted in HKD at 1.1748; a 5% CNY move is ~5% on the HKD IV

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (regular HKEX close); 52-week range 8.775-18.0; CNYHKD=X 1.1748 same date
data_sources.financials: research/6060.HK/Reports/6060.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, CNY millions) and kpis table; 6060.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt (income statement line 4096-4127, balance sheet 4196, note 25 lines 8140-8262, dividend policy 2315, placing 3569-3640, five-year summary 40-57, key ratios 1176-1199); 6060.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt (segment table 106-146, ecosystem table 199-226, key ratios 709-735, income statement 1406-1436, balance sheet 1497-1542, bonds note 2781-2797)

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2025 insurance revenue under HKFRS 17 (FY2025 AR consolidated income statement line 4096: 33,484,568 RMB'000). This is NOT gross written premiums: GWP was 35,735m in FY2025 (+6.9%) and 16,558m in H1 2026 (-0.6%, with consumer finance -79% and ex-consumer-finance +14.6%). Insurance revenue grew +5.5% in FY2025 and +12.9% in H1 2026 (16,989m) because revenue is earned with a lag to GWP; the consumer-finance run-off (insurance revenue 1,301m in H1 2026 vs 2,433m in H1 2025) is still flowing through and slows H2 2026. Pre-2023 revenue is HKFRS 4 earned premium and is not comparable.
inputs.share_count_basis: 1,684,813 thousand H+domestic shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (H1 2026 interim statement of financial position, share capital 1,684,813 RMB'000 at RMB1 par; FY2025 AR line 8603), up from 1,469,813 thousand after the July 2025 placing of 215,000,000 new H shares at HK$18.25. Basic EPS = diluted EPS (H1 2026 0.92/0.92; FY2025 0.70/0.70): no options, convertibles or treasury shares outstanding and the share-based payment charge has been nil since FY2024. Held FLAT: the FCFE stream being discounted is what the company can distribute, so modelling a further raise or a buyback as well would double-count. The 2025 placing (HK$3,895.8m net, HK$689.5m still unspent on fintech at FY2025) is already in the 30 June 2026 equity and solvency.
inputs.net_debt_treatment: Held at ZERO, the banks/insurers convention in this folder (IAG.AX, GL, PRU, LGEN.L, 1336.HK, 2378.HK). The USD senior notes (bonds payable 2,559.9m at 31 Dec 2025) were fully redeemed on 13 January 2026 (USD360.1m; USD590m had been redeemed 15 May 2025), so at 30 June 2026 the only borrowings are 68.5m of ZhongAn Technology bank loans. Securities sold under repurchase agreements (7,291m) are investment-portfolio funding inside 42.3bn of investment assets, not corporate debt, and their cost sits inside net investment income. Cash 1,538m is policyholder and investment liquidity, not shareholder surplus. Comprehensive solvency of 287.7% at 30 June 2026 (242% at FY2025) implies roughly 8bn of capital above a 200% comfort level; it is NOT added back, because the company has never distributed and the dividend policy says it intends to 'retain most, if not all' earnings -- the surplus is released only gradually through the rising payout path in the scenarios.
inputs.last_fcf_note: There is no observed FCFE: ZhongAn has never paid a dividend (DividendsPaid nil in every year FY2018-H1 2026), never bought back shares, and RAISED 3,550.7m of equity in FY2025. last_fcf is therefore the FY2025 POTENTIAL distributable: adjusted net profit attributable 1,800m (reported 1,101.6m plus the 698.5m non-cash impairment of the ZhongAn International JV, FY2025 AR line 1177) x the 40% opening payout used in the base path = 720m. An insurer's OCF-less-capex (CSV 2,489.7m for FY2025) is premium float being invested, so the identity last_fcf = reported_fcf - sbc - interest_income is deliberately not satisfied; reported_fcf is retained for auditability only.
inputs.interest_income_note: Not deducted: investment income on the insurance float (net investment income 1,851.6m FY2025) IS the business, not surplus cash, and it is inside the margin path.
inputs.sbc_source: Metrics.csv StockBasedComp: 69.7m FY2023, nil FY2024 and FY2025 (FY2025 AR cash-flow add-back line 7825 shows '--' for 2025 vs 69,672 for 2023; the share-based payments reserve is unchanged in H1 2026). The legacy scheme has fully vested and no new scheme is disclosed, so SBC is zero going forward; house and street bases coincide and band_position is null.
inputs.buyback_note: No repurchases in any year of the history; the only share-count event is the July 2025 placing (+215m shares).
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows are RMB (CNY) millions; the HKEX H-share quote is HKD. fx_rate 1.1748 HKD per CNY is Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-23 (regularMarketTime 1792753289), applied model -> quote. No A-share or ADR listing exists for a parity check; the rate is within 0.1% of the 1.1745 used for 1336.HK on 2026-10-16.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-23T08:08:08Z regular HKEX close (Yahoo chart API); 52-week range 8.775-18.0
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity, not WACC, because the flow is post-interest FCFE and net debt is held at zero. Built in CNY: 10-year China government bond ~1.8% + China equity risk premium ~7% x beta ~1.3 for a small-cap, equity-market-levered H-share fintech-insurer whose net profit swung from -1,112m (FY2022) to +4,078m (FY2023, disposal gain) to +603m (FY2024) and whose share price has halved inside 12 months from its 52-week high = ~11% base. Bull 10% (converging on the 10.5% used for the state-backed 1336.HK / 0998.HK), bear 12.5% (earnings volatility, single-market regulator, no distribution record).
inputs.lease_treatment: IFRS 16 lease liabilities 144m are immaterial (0.5% of equity); lease principal (119m FY2025) is left inside the flows via the operating-expense lines and no separate lease charge is modelled.
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests are nil on every line since FY2023 (ZhongAn International, which carried the NCI, was deconsolidated into a 43.43% joint venture in 2023). Nothing to deduct.
inputs.notes: MODEL: P&C insurer valued as FCFE at cost of equity through the engine route, the same family as IAG.AX (general insurer, FCFE on net earned premium), GL, PRU, 2378.HK and 1336.HK. The dcf-methods routing table defaults insurers to BVPS compounding x exit P/B, but ZhongAn's book is not a compounding base: equity went 15.4bn (FY2018) -> 14.9 -> 15.7 -> 16.7 -> 15.8 -> 20.1 (disposal gain) -> 20.9 -> 25.4bn (placing), i.e. almost all of the growth is a one-off gain and a capital raise, and ROE has been 2.9% (FY2024), 4.8% (FY2025), 5.9% (H1 2026 half-year) against an 11% cost of equity, so an exit P/B anchored on history would be meaningless. An owner-FCF DCF is wrong for the same reason it is wrong for every insurer here: OCF/capex are premium float and investment-portfolio flows (reported FCF -1,607, -1,501, +4,611, -864, -1,113, +1,917, +1,083, +2,490 over FY2018-25 bears no relation to earnings). ENGINE MAPPING: revenue = HKFRS 17 insurance revenue; ebitda_margin_path = profit before tax EXCLUDING share of associates/JV results and the JV impairment (those entities are valued separately in equity_bridge), as a % of insurance revenue; da_pct 0; sbc 0; cash_tax_rate 23%; capex_pct = the retention plug = margin x (1 - tax) x (1 - payout), so FCFE = after-tax profit x payout; wc 0; terminal = min(Gordon, cap multiple x FCFE). ZA BANK: held via the ZhongAn International JV (43.43%, equity-accounted; ZhongAn International is NOT consolidated -- the segment table's 'banking' column is eliminated in the 'Reconciliations' column, H1 2026 interim note 6). It is carried in the equity_bridge, not in the flows.
inputs.margin_history_note: Profit before tax excluding share of associates/JV and the JV impairment, as % of insurance revenue: FY2024 (854.2 + 130.0) / 31,744 = 3.1%; FY2025 (1,506.2 + 67.8 + 698.5) / 33,485 = 6.8%; H1 2025 (740.2 + 6.6) / 15,041 = 5.0%; H1 2026 (2,038.0 + 32.3) / 16,989 = 12.2%. H1 2026 was flattered by 817m of net fair value gains (total investment yield 7.8% annualised vs 5.3% FY2025 and 3.4% FY2024). Normalised build: underwriting profit at a 95.5-96% combined ratio = 4.0-4.5% of revenue (FY2025 1,411.6m = 4.2%); total investment income at a 4.5% yield on ~42.3bn of investment assets = ~1.9bn = ~5.3% of revenue; other income net of other operating/other expenses -1.0bn FY2025 improving to -0.5bn as the technology segment stays profitable (-255m in H1 2026) = -1.5%; other finance costs ~130m/yr now the USD notes are gone = -0.4%. Sum ~7.5-8.5%.
inputs.solvency_note: Comprehensive solvency margin ratio 472% (FY2021), 299%, 240%, 227%, 242% (FY2025), 287.7% (30 June 2026, after the placing and with the notes redeemed). Actual capital ~27bn / 2.877 implies minimum capital of ~9.5bn; a 200% comfort level needs ~19bn, so ~8bn is surplus. Minimum capital grows with premiums, so retaining ~(growth x 19bn) a year -- 1.0-1.7bn at 5-9% growth -- holds the ratio; that is what the 40-60% payout range in the base path leaves retained out of 2.4-3.8bn of after-tax profit.
inputs.fcfe_payout_note: Payout is the dominant lever. The company has never distributed, so any payout above zero is a judgment that the surplus capital is eventually the shareholders'. Base 40% -> 60% over ten years; bull 50% -> 70%; bear 20% -> 35%. The 30% bear weight is where the never-paid-a-dividend / placed-stock-at-a-9%-discount history is charged.

bear.narrative: H2 2026 gives back part of H1's fair-value gains (FY2026 margin 7.5%, still above FY2025's 6.8%), then an FY2024-like year: combined ratio back to 97% as digital lifestyle (99.2%) and NEV loss ratios rise and partner platforms renegotiate commissions, a 3.5% total investment yield in a weak A-share market, and the technology segment slipping back to losses: margin 5-5.5% (FY2024 was 3.1%). Growth 2-4% as the consumer-finance run-off is not fully replaced and a weak Chinese consumer caps discretionary covers. The Board keeps 'retaining most, if not all' and distributes only 20-35%; the rest compounds at a sub-CoE ROE. CoE 12.5%, terminal min(Gordon 12.5%/2%, 10x FCFE).

base.tax_note: 23%: H1 2026 effective 24.0% (488/2,038); FY2025 18.4% on pre-impairment PBT (405/2,205); FY2024 29.4% (251/854, non-deductible items on a small base). PRC statutory 25% with some HK/offshore income at lower rates.
base.narrative: FY2026: insurance revenue +9% (H1 +12.9%; H2 ~+5.5% as the consumer-finance run-off -- H1 2026 revenue 1,301m vs 2,433m -- keeps flowing through against health +17%, digital lifestyle +32% and auto +27% insurance revenue growth) at an 8.7% pre-tax margin = PBT ~3.2bn (H1 2.07bn already booked, H2 ~1.1bn on a 4.5% H2 investment yield and a ~96% combined ratio), after-tax ~2.4bn, EPS ~RMB1.45, payout 40% = FCFE ~1.0bn. FY2027: growth slows to 6% (full-year comparison against a consumer-finance book that is now 3% of GWP) and margin normalises to 8.0% as fair-value gains revert to a 4.5% total investment yield. FY2028-30: 6-7% growth on health (Zhong Min Bao +60%), pet and NEV, margin +0.2pp/yr to 8.5% as the expense ratio (38.6% in H1 2026, down from 40%+) keeps absorbing a loss ratio that drifts up with NEV mix; combined ratio held at 95.5-96%, i.e. no credit for the sub-95% ambition. Growth fades to 3.5% by FY2035. Payout rises ~2pp/yr from 40% to 60% as the 288% solvency ratio is allowed to drift toward ~200%. Terminal min(Gordon 11%/3% = 12.5x, 12x FCFE = 7.2x earnings at a 60% payout) -- the cap binds just below Gordon.

bull.narrative: Health, pet and NEV compound at double digits for longer (ex-consumer-finance GWP was +14.6% in H1 2026), the combined ratio reaches 94% as AI-driven expense-ratio compression (One AI, 99% automated underwriting) outruns loss-ratio drift, the technology segment's turn to profit (H1 2026 +17m vs -56m) sticks and other income net of expenses goes to zero, and a 5% total investment yield holds: margin 9.5% -> 11%. The Board starts distributing in FY2027 and the surplus capital is returned, payout 50% -> 70%. CoE 10%, terminal min(Gordon 10%/3.5%, 14x FCFE = ~10x earnings).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: 30/50/20, one notch more bearish than the 25/50/25 used for 2378.HK and 0998.HK and the same as 1336.HK. Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30% because (i) the valuation only works if capital that has NEVER been distributed in nine years as a listed company is eventually paid out -- the dividend policy says 'retain most, if not all' and the last capital event was a 2025 placing at a 9% discount; (ii) net profit is levered to the A-share market (H1 2026 PBT 2.0bn on a 7.8% annualised investment yield vs 0.7bn on 3.3% a year earlier; FY2022 was a 1.1bn loss) and the combined ratio has only been below 100% for five years; (iii) the share price halved inside 12 months from its 52-week high, so the market is pricing something close to the bear case. Bull cut from 35% to 20% because it needs the Board to start distributing, a sub-95% combined ratio and a sustained 5% investment yield at the same time.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
